mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.5% consistently indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 2.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in federal funds rate above 2.5% signals tightening policy, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.05 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and rise in non-farm payrolls signals robust labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (UNRATE decline + PAYEMS rise) produces negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.05 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Late-cycle expansion marked by high housing starts and strong consumer spending (HOUST > 950, RSAFS > 380,000) indicates overvaluation and profit-taking, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of late-cycle expansion periods (HOUST > 950, RSAFS > 380,000), or regime-specific Rank IC < 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained industrial production growth (INDPRO > 110) signals strong manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of INDPRO > 110 periods, or Rank IC < 0.05 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 950,000 units signals residential sector weakness, reducing consumer confidence and corporate revenue growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of HOUST < 950 periods, or Rank IC < 0.05 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.7% signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of UNRATE > 5.7% periods, or Rank IC < 0.05 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation above 220 signals persistent price pressures, prompting Fed tightening and higher real rates, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of CPIAUCSL > 220 periods, or Rank IC < 0.05 over 3 years.
